article.title: Justice Department: Joining protests for Cuba is a crime
article.author: Editor
article.content: “Hands Off Cuba!” picket by Minneapolis Cuba Committee June 3. Protests are crucial in fight to end U.S. gov’t blockade, threats of war. Cuban people will never give up their revolution. The post Justice Department: Joining protests for Cuba is a crime appeared first on MR Online .
